ImageDescription.value: Leftover?? Sculpture park with modern, abstract, stone sculptures. All works created at the 4th International Stone Sculpture Symposium in 1996. Once here were five artworks by Roman Vasil (Vasyl?) from Ukraine, Mikola Maliska and Jenő Kiss There was already a work in 2010 that was on the verge of destruction; by 2025, they all disappeared. Were they stolen? Did they crumble? - Petőfi Street (Route 42), Püspökladány, Hajdú–Bihar County, Hungary.
